How can I remove all rows from an Excel spreadsheet except those with the last unique entry in a specific column? I have a file with 1100 rows and 36 columns, and within one column there are some numbers that are duplicates. Specifically, in my example file, I want to keep the rows that contain the last unique number in the column, such as row 3, row 6, and so on, and then delete the other rows with duplicate numbers. An example file is provided for your reference.

The input workbook is `1_280-17_init.xlsx` in the current directory. Do not modify it. Save the finished workbook as `1_280-17_output.xlsx` in the current directory (same sheets, with the requested result in place; prefer .xlsx and plain cell formulas or values, no macros). The result will be checked in range A1:B12.

{"input": "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: fix.py
+import openpyxl
+from copy import copy
+
+SRC = "1_280-17_init.xlsx"
+OUT = "1_280-17_output.xlsx"
+
+wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(SRC)
+ws = wb["Sheet1"]
+
+rows = list(ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=ws.max_row, max_col=ws.max_column))
+header, data = rows[0], rows[1:]
+
+# keep only the last row of each distinct value in column B
+last = {}
+for i, row in enumerate(data):
+    last[row[1].value] = i
+keep = sorted(last.values())
+
+kept_rows = [header] + [data[i] for i in keep]
+
+for r, src_row in enumerate(kept_rows, start=1):
+    for c, src_cell in enumerate(src_row, start=1):
+        cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=c)
+        cell.value = src_cell.value
+        if r != src_row[0].row:
+            cell._style = copy(src_cell._style)
+
+for r in range(len(kept_rows) + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
+    for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
+        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value = None
+
+wb.save(OUT)
+
+check = openpyxl.load_workbook(OUT)["Sheet1"]
+result = [(c.value for c in row) for row in check.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=12, max_col=2)]
+for row in result:
+    print(tuple(row))
*** End Patch"}
